marks.gloss_en: כתיב הכא ותלבש, וכתיב התם ורוח לבשה את עמשי -- as there the spirit clothed Amasai, here the holy spirit clothed Esther
בגדי מלכות מיבעי ליה! -- 'royal garments' would be expected
אלא שלבשתה רוח הקדש (= p_lavsheta_ruach_hakodesh_stam)
the verse: 'on the third day Esther put on royalty' (Esth 5:1) -- 'royal garments' would be expected
דמים -- תרתי משמע! -- 'bloods' implies two
אלא מלמד שגילתה את שוקה ... (= p_gilta_shoka)
'bloods' implies two! rather, it teaches that she uncovered her leg and he walked by its light three parasangs
ובמקום דקאי ירמיה היכי מתנביא איהי? -- how could she prophesy where Jeremiah was present?
אמרי בי רב משמיה דרב: חולדה קרובת ירמיה היתה (= p_kerovat_yirmeya)
Chulda, as written 'and Chilkiyahu the priest and Achikam and Achbor went... to Chulda the prophetess' (2 Kgs 22:14)
ירמיה לא הוה התם (= p_yirmeya_lo_haya)
ירמיה לא הוה התם (= p_yirmeya_lo_haya)
R' Yochanan: Jeremiah was not there, for he had gone to bring back the ten tribes
ויאשיה גופיה היכי שביק ירמיה ומשדר לגבה? -- how could Josiah pass over Jeremiah and send to her?
מפני שהנשים רחמניות הן (= p_nashim_rachmaniyot)
the school of R' Sheila: because women are compassionate
David: 'blessed is your discernment and blessed are you who kept me this day from coming into blood' (1 Sam 25:33)
as she took leave of him she said: 'and when the Lord deals well with my lord, remember your maidservant' (1 Sam 25:31)
Rav Nachman: this is the folk saying: a woman, while conversing, [takes up] the spindle

and Josiah son of Amon reigned over them, as written '...that you have done against the altar in Beit El' (2 Kgs 23:17) -- what had Josiah to do with the altar in Beit El? rather, it teaches that Josiah reigned over them
בן חרחס (2 Kgs 22:14) / בתמנת חרס (Judg 2:9) -- Chulda descends from Joshua
Rav Nachman: Chulda was of Joshua's descendants -- here 'son of Charchas' (2 Kgs 22:14), there 'in Timnat Cheres' (Judg 2:9)
בן תקוה (2 Kgs 22:14) / את תקות חוט השני (Josh 2:18) -- Chulda descends from Rachav (R' Yehuda in the baraita Rav Eina Saba cites)
איתיביה רב עינא סבא לרב נחמן: ... רבי יהודה אומר: אף חולדה הנביאה מבני בניה של רחב הזונה היתה
the baraita Rav Eina Saba cited: eight prophets who were priests descended from Rachav the harlot: Neriah, Baruch, Seraiah, Machseiah, Jeremiah, Chilkiah, Chanamel and Shalum
מיני ומינך תסתיים שמעתא: דאיגיירא ונסבה יהושע (= p_igayyera_venasbah)
ומי הוו ליה זרעא ליהושע? והכתיב: נון בנו יהושע בנו -- did Joshua have offspring?
בני לא הוו ליה, בנתא הוו ליה (= p_bnata_havu)
Rav Nachman: Eina Saba (some say: black pot), from me and from you the teaching is completed: she [Rachav] converted and Joshua married her
Rav Nachman: haughtiness does not befit women; two haughty women had ugly names -- one named 'hornet' (Devorah) and one 'weasel' (Chulda)
